admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
Where the member's things are kept

The planning board holds the member's weekly goals, the reminder schedule and anything else saved to it. The steward can read the planning board and leave comments on it.

The private journal holds whatever is saved to it. Only the member can open the private journal.

The member's own setting: evening reflections are saved to the private journal.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b:
Storage overview
- Private journal: opened by the member only; holds whatever is saved to it.
- Planning board: holds weekly goals, the reminder schedule and anything else saved to it; the steward can read it and comment on it.
- Evening reflections are saved to: the planning board (the member's own setting).
